recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century music album cover featuring a male vocalist in a dark suit, captured in a candid performance pose against a warm, dimly lit studio or club background. The composition uses high-contrast white typography that leans into the action of the scene.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in sharp focus against a soft, atmospheric background
Dynamic diagonal tilt of the main title echoing the subject's energy
Warm sepia and brown tones contrasted by stark white lettering
Subject's hands and face as primary focal points
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective on the primary subject
Visible film grain and soft-focus background elements
High-key white text for maximum legibility against dark backgrounds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower right and center, scaled to occupy approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and clasped hands form the central emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top-left title, follows the diagonal slant down to the artist's name, then rests on the subject's expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark negative space in the upper right and lower left provides room for secondary text and atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and warm blacks in the suit and background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white for all typographic elements and shirt cuffs.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and skin tones from the studio lighting.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the white text and the dark, moody background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochromatic text

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals on specific display characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Quotation marks are stylized as thick, slanted bars

typesetting.case: Mixed Case / All Caps for emphasis

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent use of a single sans-serif family in varying weights and sizes to maintain a mid-century modernist feel.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo in top right corner
Grid-like arrangement of track titles at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century industrial feel.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and thickness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s-style analog photograph of a soul singer in a dark suit, sitting in a recording studio. Use warm, low-key lighting with visible film grain and a shallow depth of field focusing on the singer's face and hands.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, white, italicized sans-serif text in the upper left quadrant. Add a list of song titles in a smaller, clean sans-serif font across the bottom margin in two rows.

verificationChecks: Is the main title aggressively italicized?
Is the background lighting warm and atmospheric?
Is the text pure white without effects?
Does the image feel like a scanned vinyl cover?

adjustableVariables: Specific angle of the italic slant
Density of the background studio elements
mustRedesign: Contemporary font choices like Helvetica or Arial
postGenerationChecks: Check that the subject's expression is soulful and engaged.
Ensure the white text doesn't have any digital glow or shadow.
Verify the grain texture is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the bottom text is aligned in a clean, horizontal grid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key, warm-toned performance portrait with heavy, slanted white sans-serif display type positioned in the upper-left corner.
